overview: Frankish communities expressed wealth and identity through dress and skilled metalwork. The map's Frankish Kingdom record covers only part of a longer history and should not imply that Frankish culture began in 600.

items.text: Women wore belted tunics with a wrap or cloak. Pendants hung from belts, and jewelry included earrings, necklaces and hairpins.
Small paired brooches were common in earlier centuries; large single disk brooches became fashionable in the 600s.
A mid-seventh-century disk brooch combines gold with garnet, colored glass and mother-of-pearl. Small fastening objects could display elaborate material contrasts.
Charlemagne became king of the Franks in 768 and emperor in 800. Imperial culture grew from earlier Frankish traditions of patronage and fine metalwork.
